Top-left back arrow (returns to Smart Lend/Borrow overview)

Title: Lend or Borrow

Subtitle: AI-assisted lending & borrowing

(Clean, dark, premium background consistent with FinoAi design language)

Subtle AI glow or gradient accent


2. Primary Mode Selector (Main Focus)

Place prominently below the header.

Two large selectable cards (toggle behavior):

Lend — Earn Yield

Short description: Put idle savings to work


Borrow — Access Liquidity

Short description: Get funds without selling assets

Each card includes:

Icon (upward trend for Lend, liquidity/loan icon for Borrow)

Small “AI Assisted” badge

Selected state visually highlights the card

Only one mode active at a time


3. Asset & Amount Input Module

Appears immediately after mode selection.

Components:

Asset selector dropdown (USDT, ETH, BTC, SOL, KeSh,Euro, Pound etc.)

Amount input with slider + numeric entry

Balance hint below input (e.g. “Available: 2,450 USDT”)

Soft AI helper text: “Suggested based on your risk profile”


4. AI Optimization Preview Card (Value Moment)

A dynamic preview card that updates in real time.

Display:

AI-selected platform(s) or protocol path or manual input of different platforms 

Estimated APR (for Lend) or

Estimated interest + LTV (for Borrow)

Risk level badge: Low / Medium / High

Time horizon or lock duration (if applicable)


Micro-copy: “Optimized across platforms and chains in real time”

Visual style:

Glassmorphism card

Subtle animated gradient or pulse to signal live AI analysis


5. Strategy Selector (Simple Controls)

Horizontal chip selector with three options:

Safe

Balanced

Aggressive


Changing selection updates:

Yield / interest numbers

Risk badge

Lock duration visuals


No technical jargon. Visual feedback only.


6. Primary Action Button

Single, clear CTA at the bottom.

Button text adapts to selected mode:

Lend → Start Earning

Borrow → Proceed to Borrow


Button style:

Large, full-width

Gradient or AI-accent glow

Press animation


Supporting text below button: Non-custodial execution — you always control your assets

Professional, futuristic, calm

Minimal financial jargon

Focused on intent → preview → action
